verdicts.quote: The settings of an account that never changed its schedule list exactly four steps: -3, 0, +7, +14 days relative to the due date.

The user records a full payment, voids the invoice, or applies a credit that brings the balance to zero; the invoice's upcoming-reminders list becomes empty ... A partial payment keeps reminders going, now for the smaller balance.
verdicts.missing: What happens to an invoice on a payment plan; disputed invoices only stop if a user manually pauses them (U-5), so no automatic stop on dispute is decided.

verdicts.quote: An invoice of 1,000.00 with 400.00 recorded paid has reminders that state 600.00 outstanding.
After a customer confirms, no reminder is sent to that address for any invoice of that business
verdicts.missing: How an existing do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed state already on the customer record is honoured, and whether reminders are exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: Two copies of the sending process running at the same time over the same due reminders, or a restart in the middle of a run, result in each address having exactly one message per reminder.
Immediately before a message is handed to the email provider the invoice and address are checked again, and nothing is sent if the invoice is paid, void, at zero balance, paused
A temporary failure to send is retried, up to 3 attempts in all, at least 1 hour apart ... if all fail the reminder is recorded as "failed"
100,000 due reminders at 08:00 are handed to the provider no faster than N per second ... Whatever is still unsent at 18:00 waits for the next window
A reminder whose target date is earlier than the date reminders were last turned on for the account is never sent
Reminder emails are only ever sent between 08:00 and 18:00 in the account's time zone
verdicts.missing: Whether reminders go out on weekends and public holidays; and the time zone is the account's, not the customer's local time.

verdicts.quote: For a EUR invoice with 600.00 outstanding at send time, the email states 600.00 and EUR (or the € symbol)
verdicts.missing: How the amount is formatted for the recipient's locale (decimal and thousands separators, symbol placement).

verdicts.quote: An invoice with no billing email address gets its due reminders skipped and recorded as "no email address"
Each billing email address on the invoice receives its own separate message
The invoice's history shows one entry per address per reminder with: step (for example +7), target date, address, the time, and an outcome
Each reminder contains a link that opens that invoice in a browser without logging in
verdicts.missing: Whether the invoice link ever expires: C-24 only shows it working a week after payment; reference, amount and due date are covered by C-19 to C-21.

verdicts.quote: Only an account admin can change the reminder settings
Turning reminders off stops every reminder that has not yet been handed to the email provider
verdicts.missing: Turning reminders off for one customer (only per-invoice pause exists), a dry run of what would be sent, and resending a reminder by hand; a sample exists (C-40).

verdicts.quote: An invoice shows its upcoming reminders with their dates
A reminder that could not be sent on its target date can still be sent up to the end of the third calendar day after its target date, and never later
Reminders never change an invoice's status, amounts, due date, customer, billing addresses or payments
